title: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c:119 Integer underflow in tdma_tx_allowed: (slot_start - g) underflows when slot_start < LICHEN_TDMA_GUARD_MS (100).
